excerpt.zh: 噬天巨兽的最终痛苦无法人手。有过多的自我存在于这只巨兽当中，它意识的回响逐渐消逝时，我们也一同凋亡。
excerpt.en: The final agony of the Behemoth proves unbearable. Too much of us is inside of the creature, and as the echoes of its consciousness fade, so do we.
